Shares fell across Asia and Europe on Tuesday after negotiators left without an agreement. The benchmark index lost 2.1%, its worst day since March, and the dollar strengthened against most major currencies. Analysts said investors had been expecting at least a partial deal on tariffs.

A small language model that runs in the browser
We trained a 20 million parameter transformer on public domain books and compiled it to WebAssembly. It is not clever, but it completes sentences in under 50 milliseconds on a five-year-old laptop, and the whole thing is a 12 MB download. This post describes the tokenizer, the training run and the mistakes.
